[[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] was home to an ancient '''rancor graveyard''', a site primarily where the innumerable remains of [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] were gathered together in one location&mdash;although the skeletons of other creatures were also present. Situated toward the center of the graveyard was an enclosure made entirely of bones. 

A structure within the enclosure was the dwelling of [[Maris Brood]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] and took up residence there following the death of her former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. The interior of the structure was a maze of passages and irregularly shaped rooms, in one of which [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] was imprisoned by Brood following his search for Shaak Ti.

[[Galen Marek]] encountered the rancor graveyard on Felucia during his [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|second visit]] to the jungle [[Planet/Legends|world]] in search of Organa&mdash;held here during the [[Battle of Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|Felucian genocide]] by Brood, who had taken control of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Jungle Felucian]] tribes.

Maris Brood's residence was either damaged or destroyed by her pet [[Bull rancor/Legends|bull rancor]] during the ensuing confrontation between her and Marek, and later when Felucian scavengers and a herd of rancors fought over the bull rancor's carcass. The ground around the area was seemingly unstable; when Marek fought the bull rancor at the graveyard, he used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to pick up and drop the rancor, causing the ground to collapse opening into a large subterranean chamber.
